content: The most important thing is to enjoy your life - to be happy - it's all that matters.
author: Audrey Hepburn
story:
Rather than offering a polite platitude, this observation challenges how we navigate our inner lives. We are conditioned to believe that more is always better—more possessions, more accomplishments, more stimulation. Yet our accumulation usually brings more anxiety, maintenance, and mental clutter.

Audrey Hepburn understood that real peace is never won by escaping the world or blaming external circumstances. Wealth is not having endless things; it is wanting very little. When you realize that your deepest needs for peace, connection, and purpose cannot be bought, you become truly unshakeable.
reflectionPrompt: What mental clutter or unrealistic expectation can you let go of to make room for simple joy?
